name: state
meaning: ElmerState 0..15; written at the end of Elmer_SetState 0x44b074 and switched on by Update 0x449167

name: rabbitText
meaning: RABBITTEXT (property 24) localised line via Text_GetClassString (0x448c0e); spoken when the swirl sign says rabbit season (0x449e9b)

name: daffyText
meaning: DAFFYTEXT (property 8) localised line via Text_GetClassString (0x448c36); spoken when the sign says duck season (0x449ed6)

name: speed
meaning: walk speed in units/s: 0x1f4 at load and while Ralph is not the rabbit, 0x3e8 once he is (0x44a1df/0x44a27a); multiplies the sin/cos step in Elmer_MoveToward (0x44a325)

name: waitTimerMs
meaning: countdown in ms for state 8 (0x449c75): 0xfa0 on entering state 8 (0x44adad), 0x1f4 from msg 0x76 (0x44a509) and from Reset

name: unk08c
meaning: not touched by this class

name: heading
meaning: 12-bit bearing toward the move target computed by Elmer_MoveToward (0x44a136) and used as the sin/cos index (0x44a314)

name: shootTimerMs
meaning: -1 at load; set to 0x400 when Elmer is inside the moving box in state 14 (0x449fa3); decremented by g_dtMs at the end of every Update (0x44a04e). While negative the Ralph-in-moving-box test runs, otherwise it is forced true (0x4490b9)

name: unk09c
meaning: not touched by this class

name: sweepRate
meaning: 0x1000 / (anim 0 duration in ms / 2) (0x448d38): the phase rate that sweeps the gun barrel in state 5

name: sweepPhase
meaning: 12-bit phase accumulated from g_dtMs in state 5 (0x449764), reset to 0 when the animation ends

name: restart
meaning: 1 = the trajectory follower must pick its nearest waypoint again when state 5 is entered (0x44acea); set at load, on Reset and when a state re-enters the patrol

name: wolfFrozen
meaning: result of Wolf msg 0xe / 0xf (freeze / unfreeze during the shooting sequence): 0x44ada4 / 0x449444; cleared by msg 0xe (0x44a51a)

name: unk0b0
meaning: zeroed by PostLoadInit 0x448c47 and never read

name: unk0b4
meaning: not touched by this class

name: wolfSpotted
meaning: Ralph is inside DETECTBOX and answers msg 0x410 and the swirl sign answers msg 0x3080 (0x448f94): recomputed every frame

name: canAmbush
meaning: set when the XYZ distance to Ralph passes 0x15f90 (0x4490a9) and cleared on Reset and on entering state 8 (0x44adb9): gates the state-5 pounce

name: bulletBusy
meaning: result of Bullet msg 0x3201 (bullet state != 5) every frame (0x448fd9)

name: wolfIsRabbit
meaning: cached Wolf msg 0x40c (wearing the rabbit costume) read in Elmer_MoveToward (0x44a1c3); a change switches the walk animation and the speed

name: wolfFar
meaning: distance squared to Ralph > 0x31704 (0x449009)

name: wolfNear
meaning: distance squared to Ralph < 0x62e08 (0x448ff1)

name: selfInBox
meaning: Elmer's own position is inside MOVINGBOX (0x449149); forced to 1 while shootTimerMs >= 0 (0x449157)

name: wolfInBox
meaning: Ralph is inside MOVINGBOX (0x449094)

name: step
meaning: this frame's movement, the input and output of Collide_ResolveMove (0x449964, 0x44a395)

name: unk0de
meaning: not touched by this class

name: wolfPos
meaning: copy of g_pWolf->pos taken at the top of every Update (0x448e68)

name: homePos
meaning: TREESECTION's position, ground-snapped at load (0x448cb4): where Elmer stands and what he walks back to

name: movingBox
meaning: MOVINGBOX (property 20) 0x448b32: the patrol area

name: detectBox
meaning: DETECTBOX (property 12) 0x448af1

name: exceptBoxes
meaning: EXCEPTMOVINGBOX (property 16) id list via Scn_FindIdList 0x448b6e: holes inside the moving box that stop the walk

name: exceptBoxCount
meaning: count written by Scn_FindIdList (0x448b5a) and the loop bound at 0x44a436

name: unk0fe
meaning: alignment before the ContactInfo

name: contact
meaning: Collide_ResolveMove output (0x449958)

name: blocker
meaning: contact.wallObj kept when the state-5 walk is blocked (0x449b7c); state 6 waits until it is 0x3840 away

name: swirlSign
meaning: SWIRLSIGN (property 28) 0x448b98; asked msg 0x3080 for which season the sign shows

name: treeSection
meaning: TREESECTION (property 36) 0x448b81; its position is Elmer's home and it is told msg 0x3181 when he steps out

name: bullet
meaning: BULLET (property 0) 0x448ac3

name: daffy
meaning: DaffyLevel09 (class 104), found by Scenaric_FindByClass (0x448bac); never read by this class

name: camera
meaning: CAMERA (property 4) 0x448ada: {focal; rotX; rotY; rotZ; Vec3s pos} used by Camera_StartScripted (0x44a83f)

name: trajectory
meaning: TRAJECTORY (property 32) 0x448bc5: u16 point count then Vec3s points

name: follower
meaning: initialised with speed 0x50, heading bias 0x800, continuous heading, 3D distance and arrive radius 0x32 (0x448bef)

name: waypoint
meaning: the follower's waypoint index that this class drives itself: stepped by waypointDir when the follower reaches one (0x44981c), wrapped at both ends

name: waypointDir
meaning: +1 or -1; negated every time the 1000 ms patrol pause expires (0x44aab1... 0x449ab7) so Elmer walks the trajectory back and forth

name: pauseTimerMs
meaning: 1000 ms pause between patrol waypoints (0x449a97); counts down by g_dtMs (0x449a08)

name: turnRate
meaning: Math_ApproachAngle angular-velocity accumulator (0x4498d9)

name: newFacing
meaning: Math_ApproachAngle result stored before it is copied into rot.y (0x4498f7)

name: soundHandle
meaning: Sound_Play handle of the walk sound 0x100 (0x44a227); stopped at the top of Elmer_SetState (0x44a6d9)
